summary: This is a persistent DeepSeek Harness web plugin for ecommerce operations that shows data dashboards, anomaly and opportunity insights, and action lists, with support for CSV input and natural-language queries.

classificationSuggestion.reason: Based on repository evidence, this plugin is primarily a user-facing DeepSeek Harness business cockpit that visualizes ecommerce operational metrics and supports operational decision workflows, with features matching data overview, anomaly detection, action planning, and Q&A on imported or connected business data. It is classified under visualization because the core value is interactive dashboard/operational reporting rather than code generation or infrastructure tooling.
